summary.name: Deep Art Effects
summary.one_liner: Deep Art Effects is an AI image and video editing tool that applies artistic style transfer and other one-click enhancements, running offline on a PC.
use_cases: turn photos into paintings in the style of famous artists
apply artistic style transfer to videos
upscale small images to four times their size
enhance or color-correct photos in one click
generate images offline on a PC
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Deep Art Effects as a tool that transforms photos and videos into neural art using style transfer of famous artists. It offers one-click AI image processing, including scaling images to four times their original size without loss of quality, automatic optimization or colouring, imitating SLR camera looks, and automatic background cutout. The page says the processing runs fully offline on the user's PC, so pictures stay local. It also mentions Deep Art Creator for generating images from ideas, though few details are given.
notable: Runs fully offline on the PC, so pictures stay local
Upscales images to four times original size
Neural style transfer of famous artists's styles applied to photos and videos
One-click automatic background removal and color correction
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Platform support beyond PC is not detailed; web is mentioned only in the context of Deep Art Studio
